::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Slides.** [Open the deck at Part 1](../../slides/eu-frames-full.html#/part-1-credibility-and-tools){target="_blank"} in its own tab, where the `s` key opens the speaker view with the notes of each slide, or follow it on the [slides page](slides.qmd).
:::

The route opens on the question that gives the course its name. Reproduction, robustness and replication are three different ways of repeating a study, and the three can return different verdicts on the same paper, as the EU-frames case shows. This stage takes the talk from Part 1 of the full deck of the case and installs the tools, so that a machine that will not cooperate is found now rather than in the middle of a task. It takes about five and a quarter hours.

## 1. The talk of Part 1

**On the slides.** Read each slide with its speaker notes. The talk runs from the credibility debate and the red-card study, through the three Rs and the SCORE programme, to Multi100 from the position of an analyst inside it, and ends on the tools of the course.

## 2. Task 1 – The setup check

[Install R and the workspace](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), download the [workspace of the EU-frames case](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#the-workspace), and run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until every line prints OK. This is Task 1 of the exercise. Open the [browser lab](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd#task-1-setup) of the case once as well, which runs every task in a browser tab if your installation fails, and keep the [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) at hand for the problems that others have met.

## 3. The three Rs on this paper

[Read the case study at section 2.1](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-repetition){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [Reproduction, robustness and replication](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-repetition) in the case study, which says what each kind of repetition found on this paper. Then read [the tasks](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd#the-tasks) on the exercise overview, which set out the five tasks that the route works through.

## 4. The glossary

[Open the glossary](../../resources.qmd#glossary){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The glossary defines reproducibility, robustness and replicability side by side, with the other terms that the slides used.

## 5. Your IDE

[Open the module on the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [What an IDE does](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-what) in the module on the umbrella site, and the sections on the IDE that you chose, sections 2 to 8 for Positron and [section 10](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-other) for RStudio and VS Code. Then work through [the six steps](../../companion/ide.qmd#sec-try) of this case, in the workspace that you have just installed, because the six steps use every pane that the tasks need.

## 6. R from the beginning

[Open Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-what){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the first five sections of the module on the umbrella site, from [R and the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-what) to [Packages](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-packages), whose blocks run in your browser.

**Shortcuts.** If R, Quarto and an IDE are already on your machine, download the workspace, run the check and install what it reports as missing, which takes about a quarter of an hour. If you already work in one of the three IDEs, take only the six steps of the IDE module. If you write R, leave the R modules until stage 2, which says what to read in them.

**By the end of the stage** you have R, Quarto and an IDE installed, the workspace of the EU-frames case passing its setup check, and a paragraph in your own words that tells reproduction, robustness and replication apart and says what each of them found on the EU-frames case.
